description: JSON strings are Unicode, but fz currently returns {:ok, <<255>>} for Json.decode(<<34, 255, 34>>), while Elixir JSON.decode/1 returns {:error, {:invalid_byte, 1, 255}}. Json.string/2 copies every ordinary byte and never asks the Utf8 authority. Decide whether validation belongs at the decode input boundary or string completion so byte offsets stay exact, escaped Unicode remains correct, and both string values and object keys share one decision. Add an Elixir-oracled fixture across interp, run, and build, and update Json decoding documentation.

comments.text: Implemented as bcabe02d3. Added one utf8_prefix runtime authority that returns a valid first-codepoint width or the exact byte offset where the prefix becomes impossible; whole-binary fz_bitstring_valid_utf8 now folds the same decision. Utf8.next/1 exposes a branded codepoint plus rest or the original offending suffix. Json.string/2 retains its ASCII fast path and uses Utf8.next/1 only for high bytes, so malformed leading bytes and second/third/fourth continuations preserve exact source offsets for values and object keys. Added an Elixir-oracled nine-case fixture and direct Utf8.next/1 fixture across interp/JIT/AOT, exhaustive acceptance of every Unicode scalar, runtime symbol reachability coverage, Json docs, Utf8 docs, and semantic-authority docs. Proven red on all three doors before implementation. Final green: cargo test --test fixture_matrix (700), cargo test --workspace --lib (2018 compiler + 260 runtime passed; 6 ignored), cargo test --workspace --doc, cargo test --test fz2_cli (30), cargo test --test aot_variadic_open (1), cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, git diff --check, and pre-commit gates. Adjacent distinct findings were board-checked, reproduced against Elixir, and filed as fz-5xp.103 for raw control bytes and fz-5xp.104 for surrogate escapes.
Draft PR #133: https://github.com/jallum/fz/pull/133. Submitted with gh stack as the top of stack #130, based on fz-5xp.100 PR #132.

title: Json.decode accepts invalid UTF-8 inside a JSON string
